calculation_steps: If C=kappa_current*Ctilde and Q22 kappa_current=0, then C=0 and Gamma_add=0.
If w=w0*1+kappa_current*delta and Q22=0, then S(w)=w0*M^T B1^T=0 since B1M=0.
For fixed C,K,D0(P), D_s(P)=exp[s(P-P0)] D0(P) is PSD for any real s; hence Gamma_s(P)=exp[s(P-P0)]Gamma0(P).
At P0 all Gamma_s coincide, but Gamma_s_prime(P0)=Gamma0_prime(P0)+s Gamma0(P0), arbitrary if Gamma0(P0) nonzero.
Q76-Q84 kernel values are dimensionless and unchanged because no map to D_h is defined; physical loss/time/energy scales must be sourced separately.
